{{Quote|In all of my travels, I've never seen an animal stranger than the Endorian chicken, but it's not without its uses. We combine the bird's succulent meat with celonslay, space-carrots and Antarian peas, all baked in a flaky pom seed flour crust.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Endorian chicken pot pie''' was a type of [[Pie/Legends|pie]].<ref name="Dex" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the pie. The diner's owner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], wrote in the menu of his [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] that he had never seen a stranger animal than the pie's main ingredient, [[Tip-yip/Legends|Endorian chicken]], but had discovered that it was not without its uses.<ref name="Dex" />

Along with the chicken, the pie was made with the [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] [[celonslay]], [[Carrot/Legends|space-carrots]], and [[Antarian pea]]s, and was baked within a flaky [[pom seed flour]] crust. The pie was sold for 6.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as a lunch item along with a choice of lunch side. The meat of the Endorian chicken in the dish was described by Jettster as succulent.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Endorian chicken pot pie was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" />
